configurations.//: The TypeScript API over containerised PostgreSQL. Start this FIRST — Vite proxies /api to it. Needs `docker compose up -d --wait`.
configurations.name: englobe-ams-api

configurations.//: The app against the real API (VITE_AMS_BACKEND=http, via app/.env.localapi). This is the demo stack.
configurations.name: englobe-ams-localapi

configurations.//: The app against the in-browser mock — no API, no database. Useful for UI work only.
configurations.name: englobe-ams-mock

configurations.//: Verification stack on its own port, so it never collides with a demo already running on 3200. Same app, same real API.
configurations.name: englobe-ams-verify

configurations.//: Static server for the two UI mockups in docs/mockups/review-ref (design reference, not the app). Owns port 8770 to match docs/mockups/README.md - stop any manual `python3 -m http.server 8770` first.
configurations.name: englobe-ams-mockups

configurations.//: A second API on 3002, for verifying a change while another session's demo holds 3001. Pair with englobe-ams-verify, which sets AMS_API_PORT to match.
configurations.name: englobe-ams-api-alt
